name: Location Category 3 Code
definition: Indicates the type of integration of the POI terminal in the sale environment.

IPMP.name: Inside Pump
IPMP.definition: Terminal incorporated in the pump dispensing petrol.

MPOI.name: Multiple POI Terminal
MPOI.definition: Multiple terminals linked to a unique sale terminal.

MPMP.name: Multiple Pump
MPMP.definition: Outdoor terminal serving several petrol pumps.

SSLE.name: Single Sale Terminal
SSLE.definition: Terminal linked to a unique sale terminal.

VNDG.name: Vending Machine
VNDG.definition: Terminal integrated in a vending machine.
